objective: Restyle every form control in the human's 'soft filled' direction (no outline at rest, a muted fill, a 12 px radius, 48 px tall, the label above; a lighter fill and an accent ring on focus; a custom select chevron; a leading search icon) and add the shared primitives the stats and compose redesign needs: an in-page SegmentedTabs bar, a FloatingButton, a SearchInput, and the circle-plus, paperclip and circle-x icons, without changing the post cards or the thread.
acceptance_criteria: Every single-line text control (text, email, password, search, number, date), every select and every textarea, styled in styles/base.css and FormField, is 'soft filled' in both themes: no border at rest, a fill from a new field token (e.g. --color-field) distinct from --color-surface and --color-bg, a new --radius-lg of 12 px, a minimum height of 3rem (48 px) for single-line controls and selects, horizontal padding --space-4, and the label above the control as today; tokens.css defines each new token in light and dark, and no module CSS uses a literal colour (the existing token scans).

Focus: the fill changes to a lighter field-focus token and --focus-ring (the accent) appears as an outline or box-shadow, never as a border or padding change, so focusing a control moves nothing (its border box is identical focused and unfocused, pinned in a test from the CSS); invalid (aria-invalid="true"): a --color-danger ring at rest, the existing error text unchanged; disabled: --opacity-disabled and cursor not-allowed.

Contrast, from the tokens in both themes and checked in a test: placeholder text against the field fill at least 4.5:1; the control's boundary (the field fill against the background it sits on, --color-bg and --color-surface) at least 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). If a fill can't reach 3:1 against both, the control gets a 1 px bottom rule in --color-border-strong at rest, and the PR says which.

Selects: appearance none with a custom chevron at the end, inside the control, with the text never under the chevron; the chevron uses no network request and needs no new Content-Security-Policy source (a CSS mask or border trick, or an inline SVG data URI only if the existing CSP already allows data: images, which the PR states).

components/ui/SearchInput.tsx: a search field with a leading SearchIcon (aria-hidden, inside the fill, the text padded past it), taking the props of an input plus its label wiring through FormField; features/search/SearchBar uses it, and its form, role="search", name and behaviour are unchanged.

components/ui/SegmentedTabs.tsx: an in-page tab bar (ARIA tablist: role tablist, tab with aria-selected and aria-controls, tabpanel with aria-labelledby; arrow keys and Home/End move and select, one tab in the tab order), controlled by props { label, tabs: { id, label }[], value, onChange }; horizontal, each tab at least 44 px tall, the selected tab a filled pill on --color-action with --color-on-action text, the others --color-text-muted; when the tabs overflow at 360 wide the bar scrolls horizontally inside itself and the page never scrolls sideways; distinct from the route-based Tabs, which is unchanged.

components/ui/FloatingButton.tsx: a 56 px circular action fixed at the bottom right, --color-action fill, --shadow-2, --focus-ring on focus, an accessible name required by its props (aria-label), rendered as a link or a button (an `as`/`to` prop); on phones it sits above the bottom navigation bar and clear of env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and from 40em it sits --space-5 from the viewport's corner. It has no caller in this unit.

icons/index.tsx adds CirclePlusIcon (`circle-plus`), PaperclipIcon (`paperclip`) and CircleXIcon (`circle-x`), copied from Lucide like the others (ISC, the existing LICENSE), with the same size and className props; icons.test.tsx covers them.

The post cards and the thread are untouched: no file under features/feed, features/thread or features/compose changes, and Button, Card, Avatar, Badge, Dialog, Menu and Skeleton render exactly as before (their tests unchanged).
Reduced motion and calm: any transition on the field's fill or ring is at most 120 ms and is removed under prefers-reduced-motion; no keyframes at-rule (styles/base.test.ts).

Baseline (provisional, the skeptic's to confirm or tighten before the branch is cut): no new dependency; no new network request on any page; the main JS chunk grows by at most 3 kB gzip and the CSS by at most 4 kB gzip (both build outputs in the PR body); no new runtime work (no JS for styling, no resize or scroll listener); every existing frontend test passes; typecheck, lint and build pass with no chunk-size warning.
0x08-frontend.md records the field tokens, the focus and invalid rules, and the three primitives (FrontendUI/components.md rows go in a Director PR: no unit role may write FrontendUI/).

Browser rows (vite preview against backend-dev, light and dark, 360 and 1280 wide): sign in, sign up, profile settings (text, date, select, textarea), the search bar, Stats > Players search, the team search, the season select and the compose text box and file pick all show the soft-filled style; tabbing shows the ring and nothing moves; an invalid sign-in field shows the danger ring and its message; placeholder and boundary contrast measured in DevTools match the test; a SegmentedTabs and a FloatingButton mounted on a scratch route in the preview only (not committed) behave as specified at 360, including horizontal overflow and the bottom bar; no post card or thread looks different (screenshots before and after).
